# Home of Creativity (HOC / بيت الإبداع)

> Home of Creativity (HOC) — بيت الإبداع — is a creative and branding agency based in Al Hamra, Damascus, Syria. It works with clients in Syria and Saudi Arabia, including Riyadh, as a served market. Official site: https://hoc.agency/

Also known as: HOC, بيت الإبداع, بيت الابداع, Creativation Source.

Home of Creativity does not claim star ratings, review counts, or "#1 agency" rankings.

## Facts

- Legal / brand name: Home of Creativity (HOC)
- Arabic name: بيت الإبداع
- Website: https://hoc.agency/
- Office (only physical location): Al Hamra, Damascus, Syria — https://hoc.agency/locations/damascus/
- Markets served: Syria and Saudi Arabia, including Riyadh. Riyadh is a served market, not a second office.
- Contact: Telegram and WhatsApp from https://hoc.agency/ (WhatsApp https://wa.me/963954187154; Saudi contact number +966 55 035 0295)
- Languages: Arabic and English
- How work starts: quotation from Home of Creativity; payment confirmed on WhatsApp; no self-serve web checkout
- Not published: founding year, team roster, awards, client counts, industry list, ratings

## Services

Visual identities; social media; account management; marketing; paid ads; exhibitions and conferences; event management; booth design; filming and editing; promo gifts; roadside ads; websites and ecommerce; app design; financial analysis.
